name: Deep Freeze
description:
Deals ice damage with a potency of 300 to all enemies in a straight line.
Potency increases to 390 when used against targets weak to ice.
Drain Touch Potency: 400
Potency increases to 520 when used against targets weak to ice.
Potency scales with item level.
Consumes 10% of maximum HP when executed.
Additional Effect: Freezes time for target when under the effect of Drain Touch
Duration: 4s
Additional Effect: Afflicts yourself with Doom
Duration: 10s
Effect is dispelled when HP is restored to full.
